$schema_note: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Per-client factor sensitivities for the Scenarios tab. beta_oil is NOT authored: generate_scenario_tables.py solves it so that the 'oil-shock' preset reproduces each client's agreed EBITDA impact in scenario.json exactly. All other betas are authored by business model. EBITDA % change = beta_oil*oil% + beta_gas*gas% + beta_fx*usdcad% + beta_demand*demand%.

presets.name: Canadian recession
presets.note: Demand contraction, oil lower, spreads wider, BoC eases.

presets.name: Middle East conflict escalation
presets.note: Supply-route risk lifts crude and gas; risk-off widens credit; CAD firms with oil.
presets.web_query: military conflict or escalation in the Middle East affecting oil supply, shipping or the Strait of Hormuz
presets.channels: Oil and gas up, spreads wider, inflation premium in rates, CAD stronger, softer global demand.

presets.name: Japan interest rate spike
presets.note: JGB yields jump and the yen carry trade unwinds; global term premium and spreads reprice.
presets.web_query: Japanese government bond yields, Bank of Japan rate hikes, or yen carry trade unwinding
presets.channels: Global term premium lifts rates, risk-off widens spreads, USD/CAD up, commodities soften.

presets.name: Extreme weather disruption
presets.note: Hurricanes, wildfires or a severe winter shut in production and spike gas demand.
presets.web_query: extreme weather such as hurricanes, wildfires, floods or cold snaps disrupting North American energy production or infrastructure
presets.channels: Gas sharply higher, crude modestly higher on shut-ins, industrial activity and rail/logistics disrupted.

presets.name: Global food supply shock
presets.note: Crop failures and export bans push food inflation; fertiliser and diesel demand rise.
presets.web_query: global food shortages, crop failures, grain export bans or food price inflation
presets.channels: Food inflation keeps rates higher, gas (fertiliser feedstock) and diesel up, consumer demand squeezed.

presets.name: Deadly disease outbreak
presets.note: A fast-spreading outbreak triggers travel curbs and a demand collapse; central banks ease.
presets.web_query: deadly infectious disease outbreaks, epidemics or WHO public health emergency declarations
presets.channels: Demand and crude collapse, spreads gap wider, rates rally hard, USD/CAD up on risk-off.

presets.name: US-Canada tariff escalation
presets.note: Broad US tariffs on Canadian goods with retaliation; CAD weakens and trade-exposed names re-rate.
presets.web_query: United States tariffs on Canadian goods, Canada retaliatory tariffs, CUSMA/USMCA trade negotiations
presets.channels: Tariff hits exporters' EBITDA, CAD weaker, cross-border demand softer, spreads wider, BoC leans dovish.

CLI-1001.model: Fee-based midstream with a crude-marketing segment; USD-linked revenue.
CLI-1001.tariff_note: Energy flows largely tariff-exempt; marketing margins dip with lower volumes.

CLI-1002.model: NGL midstream; frac spreads tie it to gas.
CLI-1002.tariff_note: NGL exports exposed only at the margin; fee-based core.

CLI-1003.model: Light-oil producer; USD-priced barrels, CAD costs.
CLI-1003.tariff_note: Crude exported to US refiners; tariff widens the WCS discount.

CLI-1004.tariff_note: Domestic energy services; second-order activity effect.

CLI-1005.model: Utility poles and rail ties; diesel and fibre inputs.
CLI-1005.tariff_note: Utility poles and rail ties sold heavily into the US.

CLI-1006.model: Metals service centres with an energy-tubulars segment.
CLI-1006.tariff_note: Steel tariffs lift North American metal prices and inventory gains.

CLI-1007.model: Packaging and tissue; energy and fibre are inputs.
CLI-1007.tariff_note: Cross-border packaging and tissue plants and customers.

CLI-1008.tariff_note: Farm equipment built in Canada and sold into US agriculture.

CLI-1009.model: Remote retail; imported goods, fuel and freight costs.
CLI-1009.tariff_note: Northern retail; mostly domestic sourcing and sales.

CLI-1010.tariff_note: US propane distribution and cross-border supply.

world_severity.$note: Web IQ reports a severity per theme; the BFF (not the agent) maps it to an intensity on the governed preset shock.
